label.zh: MTP（模型自带多 token 预测）
草稿模型（需要草稿模型）

message.zh: 这个模型的权重里没有 MTP 层，不能使用 MTP 推测解码；请关闭推测解码或换用其他方式。
message.en: This checkpoint has no MTP layers, so MTP speculative decoding cannot start; turn speculative decoding off or pick another method.

message.zh: 这种推测解码方式必须指定草稿模型，请在“草稿模型”里选择一个，或换用其他方式。
message.en: This speculative decoding method needs a draft model; choose one in “Draft model” or pick another method.

summary.zh: vLLM 启动时按每张卡总显存的这个比例预留，其余留给其它程序。
summary.en: vLLM reserves this fraction of each GPU's total memory at start; the rest stays free for other programs.

what.zh: 对应 --gpu-memory-utilization。预留量包括权重、激活和 KV 缓存，权重之外剩下的都用作 KV 缓存。
what.en: Maps to --gpu-memory-utilization. The reservation covers weights, activations and KV cache; whatever is left after the weights becomes KV cache.

whenToChange.zh: 同一张卡还要运行其它模型或桌面程序时调小；独占显卡、需要更多 KV 缓存时调大。
whenToChange.en: Lower it when other models or desktop apps share the GPU; raise it for a dedicated GPU that needs more KV cache.

tradeoffs.zh: 过高会与其它进程争抢显存、导致启动失败；过低则 KV 缓存不足，上下文或并发受限。
tradeoffs.en: Too high fights other processes for memory and can fail the start; too low leaves too little KV cache for context or concurrency.

message.zh: 并行实例与其它模型共用显卡，整卡预留比例超过 0.7 容易挤占其它实例。
message.en: A parallel instance shares the GPU with other models; reserving more than 0.7 of it can crowd them out.

label.zh: 每步调度 token 上限

summary.zh: 每个调度步最多处理的 token 数，决定预填充分块的大小。
summary.en: The most tokens processed per scheduler step, which sets the prefill chunk size.

what.zh: 对应 --max-num-batched-tokens。不设置时使用引擎默认值。
what.en: Maps to --max-num-batched-tokens. Unset uses the engine default.

whenToChange.zh: 长提示词等很久才开始回答时调大；生成过程断断续续时调小。
whenToChange.en: Raise it when long prompts take a long time before the answer starts; lower it when generation stutters.

tradeoffs.zh: 越大预填充越快，但激活显存越多，也会拉长其它请求的出字间隔。
tradeoffs.en: Larger values prefill faster but use more activation memory and delay other requests' tokens.

summary.zh: 每张卡把这么多 GiB 的权重放到系统内存，用到时再搬运。
summary.en: Moves this many GiB of weights per GPU to system RAM and streams them in when needed.

what.zh: 对应 --cpu-offload-gb，用 PCIe 带宽换显存。
what.en: Maps to --cpu-offload-gb; it trades PCIe bandwidth for GPU memory.

whenToChange.zh: 模型只差一点就能放进显卡时。
whenToChange.en: When the model is only slightly too big for the GPU.

tradeoffs.zh: 每生成一个 token 都要搬运权重，速度会明显下降。
tradeoffs.en: Weights cross PCIe for every token, so generation slows down noticeably.

summary.zh: 把最多这么多 GiB 的 KV 缓存放到系统内存，保留更多可复用的前缀。
summary.en: Keeps up to this many GiB of KV cache in system RAM so more reusable prefixes survive.

what.zh: 对应 --kv-offloading-size，是所有卡的总量，不是每张卡。
what.en: Maps to --kv-offloading-size; it is a total for all GPUs, not per GPU.

whenToChange.zh: 多轮对话或共享前缀很多、显存里的前缀缓存经常被挤掉时。
whenToChange.en: When multi-turn chats or shared prefixes are common and the prefix cache in GPU memory keeps getting evicted.

tradeoffs.zh: 占用系统内存；从内存取回比重新计算快，但比显存慢。
tradeoffs.en: Uses system RAM; fetching from RAM beats recomputing but is slower than GPU memory.

summary.zh: 缓存图片等多模态输入的预处理结果，重复输入时更快。
summary.en: Caches preprocessed images and other multimodal inputs so repeats are faster.

what.zh: 对应 --mm-processor-cache-gb，占用系统内存。0 表示关闭缓存。
what.en: Maps to --mm-processor-cache-gb and uses system RAM. 0 turns the cache off.

whenToChange.zh: 内存紧张时调小或设为 0；经常重复发送相同图片时调大。
whenToChange.en: Lower it or use 0 when RAM is tight; raise it when the same images are sent again and again.

tradeoffs.zh: 只占用系统内存，不影响显存。
tradeoffs.en: Uses system RAM only, not GPU memory.

summary.zh: GGUF 模型使用的 Hugging Face 配置来源。
summary.en: The Hugging Face config source used for a GGUF model.

what.zh: 对应 --hf-config-path，可以填写仓库名或目录。
what.en: Maps to --hf-config-path; a repository name or a folder.

whenToChange.zh: GGUF 文件里的配置不完整、vLLM 识别不出架构时。
whenToChange.en: When the GGUF's embedded config is incomplete and vLLM cannot identify the architecture.

tradeoffs.zh: 配置与权重不匹配会加载失败或输出异常。
tradeoffs.en: A config that does not match the weights fails to load or produces bad output.

summary.zh: 多模态模型只加载文本部分，省下视觉编码器的显存。
summary.en: Loads only the text part of a multimodal model and saves the vision encoder's memory.

what.zh: 对应 --language-model-only。开启后不能再处理图片输入。
what.en: Maps to --language-model-only. Image inputs no longer work.

whenToChange.zh: 只做文本对话、显存紧张时。
whenToChange.en: When you only chat in text and memory is tight.

tradeoffs.zh: 部分不是纯语言模型的架构不支持，这时会被忽略。
tradeoffs.en: Some architectures are not plain language models; for them it is ignored.

summary.zh: 多卡运行时，vLLM 用哪种方式管理工作进程。
summary.en: How vLLM manages its worker processes across GPUs.

what.zh: mp 用于单机多卡；ray 用于多台机器或集群。
what.en: mp is for several GPUs on one host; ray is for several hosts or a cluster.

whenToChange.zh: 跨机器部署时选 ray。
whenToChange.en: Choose ray when deploying across machines.

tradeoffs.zh: ray 需要额外的集群组件，单机上通常没有好处。
tradeoffs.en: ray needs extra cluster components and rarely helps on a single host.

message.zh: ray 后端在 Windows 的 Docker/WSL 环境下未经验证。
message.en: The ray backend is unverified under Docker/WSL on Windows.

label.zh: 禁用 CUDA Graph（逐步执行）

summary.zh: 不捕获 CUDA Graph，按逐步执行的方式运行。
summary.en: Skips CUDA graph capture and runs step by step.

what.zh: 对应 --enforce-eager。启动更快、更省显存，但生成速度下降。
what.en: Maps to --enforce-eager. It starts faster and uses less memory, but generates more slowly.

whenToChange.zh: 在捕获 CUDA Graph 的阶段崩溃或卡住时，用来排查和绕过。
whenToChange.en: To work around crashes or hangs while CUDA graphs are being captured.

tradeoffs.zh: 解码速度会明显变慢。
tradeoffs.en: Decoding becomes noticeably slower.

summary.zh: 让 CPU 调度与 GPU 计算同时进行，减少每一步的额外开销。
summary.en: Overlaps CPU scheduling with GPU work to cut the overhead of each step.

what.zh: 对应 --async-scheduling。
what.en: Maps to --async-scheduling.

whenToChange.zh: 已验证的方案需要它，或 CPU 调度成为瓶颈时。
whenToChange.en: When a validated recipe needs it, or CPU scheduling is the bottleneck.

tradeoffs.zh: 这是较新的功能，与部分特性同时使用时可能不稳定。
tradeoffs.en: A newer feature that can be unstable together with some other features.

summary.zh: 选择注意力计算使用的实现。
summary.en: Chooses the implementation used for attention.

what.zh: 对应 --attention-backend。不设置时 vLLM 按显卡和模型自动选择。
what.en: Maps to --attention-backend. Unset, vLLM picks one for the GPU and model.

whenToChange.zh: 自动选择的后端在当前显卡或模型上崩溃或输出异常时。
whenToChange.en: When the automatically chosen backend crashes or misbehaves on this GPU or model.

tradeoffs.zh: 不同后端的速度和支持的功能不同，选错可能无法启动。
tradeoffs.en: Backends differ in speed and supported features; a wrong one may not start.

summary.zh: MoE 模型专家层使用的计算实现。
summary.en: The kernel implementation for a MoE model's expert layers.

what.zh: 对应 --moe-backend。
what.en: Maps to --moe-backend.

whenToChange.zh: 量化的 MoE 模型输出异常或速度不理想时，按已验证方案选择。
whenToChange.en: When a quantized MoE model gives bad output or runs slowly, pick the backend a validated recipe names.

tradeoffs.zh: 部分后端只支持特定显卡架构，例如 flashinfer_b12x 需要 SM12x。
tradeoffs.en: Some backends need a specific GPU architecture; flashinfer_b12x, for example, needs SM12x.

summary.zh: 量化线性层使用的计算实现。
summary.en: The kernel implementation for quantized linear layers.

what.zh: 对应 --linear-backend。
what.en: Maps to --linear-backend.

whenToChange.zh: 已验证的方案指定了线性层后端时。
whenToChange.en: When a validated recipe names a linear backend.

tradeoffs.zh: 不匹配的后端可能无法加载权重或变慢。
tradeoffs.en: A mismatched backend may fail to load the weights or run slower.

summary.zh: 用 JSON 覆盖默认的生成参数，例如 max_new_tokens 或 temperature。
summary.en: Overrides default generation values as JSON, for example max_new_tokens or temperature.

what.zh: 对应 --override-generation-config，在模型自带的生成配置之上生效。
what.en: Maps to --override-generation-config and applies on top of the model's own generation config.

whenToChange.zh: 客户端不传 max_tokens 时会一直生成到上下文用完，需要给一个默认上限时。
whenToChange.en: When clients that omit max_tokens would generate until the context runs out and you need a default cap.

tradeoffs.zh: 请求里明确给出的值仍然优先。
tradeoffs.en: Values a request states explicitly still win.

summary.zh: 权重文件的读取方式；prefetch 会提前把文件读入内存。
summary.en: How weight files are read; prefetch reads the files ahead into memory.

what.zh: 对应 --safetensors-load-strategy。
what.en: Maps to --safetensors-load-strategy.

whenToChange.zh: 模型放在较慢的磁盘或网络存储上、加载很慢时可试 prefetch。
whenToChange.en: Try prefetch when the model sits on slow or network storage and loading takes long.

tradeoffs.zh: prefetch 加载时会占用更多系统内存。
tradeoffs.en: prefetch uses more system RAM while loading.

summary.zh: 模型目录里自带的思考解析器插件文件。
summary.en: A reasoning-parser plugin file shipped in the model folder.

what.zh: 对应 --reasoning-parser-plugin，用于引擎还没有内置解析器的新模型。
what.en: Maps to --reasoning-parser-plugin, for new models whose parser the engine does not ship yet.

whenToChange.zh: 模型说明要求加载自带的解析器插件时。
whenToChange.en: When the model card asks you to load its own parser plugin.

tradeoffs.zh: 插件是模型仓库提供的 Python 代码，只用于可信来源的模型。
tradeoffs.en: The plugin is Python code from the model repository; use it only for models from trusted sources.

summary.zh: 用一个 JSON 对象覆盖模型 config.json 里的字段。
summary.en: Overrides fields of the model's config.json with a JSON object.

what.zh: 对应 --hf-overrides。最长 8 KiB。扩展上下文时可填 {"rope_scaling":{"rope_type":"yarn","factor":4,"original_max_position_embeddings":32768}}，辅助界面会帮你生成。
what.en: Maps to --hf-overrides. At most 8 KiB. To extend the context use {"rope_scaling":{"rope_type":"yarn","factor":4,"original_max_position_embeddings":32768}}; a helper in the console builds it for you.

whenToChange.zh: 需要改模型配置而不想复制整个模型目录，例如用 YaRN 扩展上下文，或修正错误的架构名。
whenToChange.en: When you need to change the model config without copying the model folder, for example to extend the context with YaRN or fix a wrong architecture name.

tradeoffs.zh: 字段写错或和权重不匹配会让加载失败或输出异常；它会改变模型行为，请对照模型卡。
tradeoffs.en: A wrong field or one that does not match the weights fails to load or garbles output; it changes model behaviour, so check it against the model card.

summary.zh: 用你提供的 Jinja 聊天模板文件，替换模型自带的模板。
summary.en: Replaces the model's own template with a Jinja chat template file you provide.

what.zh: 对应 --chat-template。文件必须在平台的模型存储目录下。
what.en: Maps to --chat-template. The file must be under the platform's model storage roots.

whenToChange.zh: 模型自带模板有缺陷、缺少工具调用或思考开关，或者官方发布了修正后的模板时。
whenToChange.en: When the model's own template is faulty, lacks tool calling or a thinking switch, or an official fixed template was published.

tradeoffs.zh: 模板和模型不匹配会让输出格式出错；只在确认模板来源可靠时使用。
tradeoffs.en: A template that does not fit the model breaks the output format; use it only when you trust where the template came from.

summary.zh: 这个模型是对话模型、向量（embedding）模型还是重排序模型。
summary.en: Whether this model is a chat model, an embedding model or a reranker.

what.zh: chat 不加任何参数；embedding 对应 --runner pooling --convert embed；rerank 对应 --runner pooling --convert classify。
what.en: chat adds nothing; embedding maps to --runner pooling --convert embed; rerank maps to --runner pooling --convert classify.

whenToChange.zh: 启动向量模型或重排序模型时。对话模型保持默认。
whenToChange.en: When you start an embedding or reranking model. Leave chat models at the default.

tradeoffs.zh: embedding 和 rerank 实例不提供对话接口。
tradeoffs.en: Embedding and rerank instances do not serve the chat API.

summary.zh: 启动时加载的 LoRA 适配器，每个有名字和目录，最多 8 个。
summary.en: LoRA adapters loaded at launch, each with a name and a folder, up to 8.

what.zh: 对应 --enable-lora --lora-modules 名字=路径 …。客户端在请求的 model 字段里写适配器名字即可使用。路径必须在平台的模型存储目录下。
what.en: Maps to --enable-lora --lora-modules name=path …. Clients select an adapter by putting its name in the request's model field. Paths must be under the platform's model storage roots.

whenToChange.zh: 同一个基础模型要服务多个微调版本时。
whenToChange.en: When one base model must serve several fine-tuned variants.

tradeoffs.zh: 开启 LoRA 会占用额外显存并略微降低吞吐；适配器的秩不能超过“LoRA 最大秩”。
tradeoffs.en: Enabling LoRA uses extra VRAM and lowers throughput slightly; an adapter's rank cannot exceed “LoRA max rank”.

label.zh: 同时加载的 LoRA 数

summary.zh: 同一批请求里最多能同时用到几个不同的 LoRA。
summary.en: How many different LoRAs one batch of requests may use at once.

what.zh: 对应 --max-loras。只在配置了 LoRA 适配器时生效。
what.en: Maps to --max-loras. It only takes effect when LoRA adapters are configured.

whenToChange.zh: 多个适配器会同时被不同请求使用时调大。
whenToChange.en: Raise it when several adapters are used by different requests at the same time.

tradeoffs.zh: 每多一个槽位都会预留一份适配器显存。
tradeoffs.en: Every extra slot reserves another adapter's worth of VRAM.

summary.zh: 允许加载的 LoRA 适配器的最大秩。
summary.en: The largest rank of a LoRA adapter that may be loaded.

what.zh: 对应 --max-lora-rank，范围 1 到 512。必须不小于所有适配器的实际秩。
what.en: Maps to --max-lora-rank, 1 to 512. It must be at least the real rank of every adapter.

whenToChange.zh: 适配器的秩大于默认上限，启动时报秩过大的错误时。
whenToChange.en: When an adapter's rank is above the default limit and startup reports the rank as too large.

tradeoffs.zh: 上限越大，为每个槽位预留的显存越多。
tradeoffs.en: A higher limit reserves more VRAM for every slot.
